entities.summary: Cephas Yao Agbemenu is a Ghanaian sculptor, and educator. He is an art professor who teaches at the Kenyatta University in Nairobi, Kenya. He is a sculptor and a traditional African wood carver, who sees parallels between his carvings and life.
